student_data.notes: Data derived from Fall 2024 Enrollment Summary by Major. Undergrad count is high due to OSU's large online post-baccalaureate Computer Science program (Ecampus). Breakdown: 4,583 Undergraduate CS majors (primary + secondary majors); Graduate count combines MS (286) and PhD (175) for Computer Science explicitly. Does not include Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE) students. [WARNING: Original source was inaccessible, using fallback.]
